bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs, document.rs, pasteboard.rs, restoration.rs, workspace.rs, observable.rs
summary: App lifecycle, documents, pasteboard, state restoration, workspace and sandbox permissions have SDK counterparts. Liquid Glass-style materials exist in the renderer. Cocoa Bindings, nib/storyboard loading, app extensions and iCloud have no equivalent.

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/glass.rs (Kind, Look, Style: vibrancy hook); springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-17.rs; docs/gpu-first.md
features.note: The look of each material kind, its dark and light mix, the filter arithmetic and the rim and vibrancy rules are tested headless. Gap: the SDK exposes no material type, so an app cannot request glass, and the live blur runs only on the GPU presenter, which needs the lab machine.

The reference is Apple's release-notes article for AppKit: a vendor publication with no runtime behaviour, so there is no framework capability to mirror. BifrOSt's counterpart is its own release notes in CHANGELOG.md, written by the release process.

Manifest permissions map to launch flags, unknown ones are refused, and remote sharing and the journal entitlement are restricted; tested headless. Bubblewrap sandbox and file grants remain. Gap: there is no TCC-style prompt for each data class.
Apple hardware migration; packages are x86_64-linux

features.apple: NSApplication, NSWorkspace, NSRunningApplication, app delegate, process info
features.note: Sudden termination, activity unions, thermal states, low power and workspace notification names are tested headless; memory-pressure callbacks exist through dispatch. Gap: occlusion-driven suspension is still planned (task/008-lifecycle-recovery.md) and needs the lab machine.

features.apple: Document model, open/save panels, autosave, versions
features.note: Document model and panels exist; see docs/bifrost-ui.md Documents section for gaps

Named boards, per-type data, types and change counts are tested headless (headless_clipboard_* in sdk/tests). Shell publishes only one text-like type to Wayland selection; other types stay inside BifrOSt

features.apple: iCloud document storage and key-value sync
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Wave 3 (theme-01, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Cloud sync lives in ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud (outside this repo); no SDK API for apps
